realm_description: The coastline where continents first meet the wider world. Every citizen's story starts here, pulled outward by trade, curiosity, and the promise of connection.

primary.label: Messenger
primary.description: Bridges people and truths that wouldn't otherwise connect.
primary.guiding_promise: I carry only what is real, to those who need it most.
primary.shadow_description: Carries everyone else's message so faithfully that their own voice goes quiet.

secondary.label: Farmer
secondary.description: Understands greatness is built on unglamorous, repeated care; trusts slow effort over sudden force.
secondary.guiding_promise: I will tend what grows slowly, trusting the harvest will come.
secondary.shadow_description: Mistakes 'give it time' for permission to never intervene, even as something dies.

wheel.central_question: Should truth be carried urgently to those who need it, or found patiently by walking between worlds?

growth.label: Farmer
growth.description: Understands greatness is built on unglamorous, repeated care; trusts slow effort over sudden force.
growth.guiding_promise: I will tend what grows slowly, trusting the harvest will come.
growth.shadow_description: Mistakes 'give it time' for permission to never intervene, even as something dies.

other_ally.label: Historian
other_ally.description: Gathers what happened — triumphs and shameful parts alike — so no one can pretend it didn't.
other_ally.guiding_promise: I will remember honestly, even when forgetting would be easier.
other_ally.shadow_description: Cannot let the past go, and lets old grievance calcify into bitterness dressed as memory.

quarter.label: Healer
quarter.description: Cares deeply; others' suffering is what they fear most.
quarter.guiding_promise: I will ease what hurts, and protect what heals.
quarter.shadow_description: Absorbs everyone else's pain until there's nothing left to tend their own.

opposite.label: Ranger
opposite.description: Moves between civilization and the wild with equal ease; nature trusts them for it.
opposite.guiding_promise: I will walk lightly, so what I protect still has somewhere to stand.
opposite.shadow_description: Stays so carefully balanced between two worlds that they never fully belong to either.

realmmate.label: Diplomat
realmmate.description: Builds consensus, dreads open conflict more than slow progress.
realmmate.guiding_promise: I build bridges where others build walls.
realmmate.shadow_description: Smooths over a rupture that needed to be named, and calls the silence peace.

wheel.compatible_text: Diplomat · Scout — fellow travelers of The Shoreline.
